object_description: simple compact rectangular four-story school volume
design_condition: The compact building is precisely set parallel and slightly back from the street, creating a generous western outdoor space while responding to the surrounding height, proportions, trees and slight level differences.

positive.statement: The building naturally fits into the surrounding development in terms of location, height and proportion.
The compact footprint creates a generous and logically structured outdoor space.
The simple typology offers clear orientation, high flexibility and spatial, functional and visual permeability.
The operational requirements are coherently implemented in the architectural space.
The compactness and clear typology produce very good cost indicators.
The energy goals are implemented in a self-evident way through compactness, insulation, solar gains and building technology.

negative.statement: The lighting of the design space in the basement remains in need of improvement.
The facade has a rather restless and somewhat random-looking expression.
The access side to the street is unsatisfactory and needs to be fundamentally revised.
